question: Should this phase-safe stuck-recovery contract become the canonical reply/embedded recovery path after a current-main refresh and coordination with the stalled-interruption PR?
rationale: The patch has no discrete correctness defect, but accepting its cross-layer ownership and terminal-state contract requires human intent because a mistake can affect tool replay, fallback, queued-turn serialization, and adjacent terminal projection.

options.title: Refresh, coordinate, and land
options.body: Review the exact current-main merge result, reconcile terminal semantics with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103990, and land this PR if the ownership invariants and focused checks remain intact.

options.title: Pause for a unified replacement
options.body: Hold this PR and replace both recovery branches with one maintainer-owned refactor if the overlapping reply terminal contracts cannot be reconciled cleanly.
